requirement.text: The system shall be easy to upgrade.

classification.rationale: Neither the target requirement nor the context document contains any specific indicators for web, mobile, or AI technologies, making it a generic maintainability requirement that falls under 'other'.

rounds.text_checked: The system shall be easy to upgrade.

issues.explanation: The adjective 'easy' is subjective and vague, lacking a measurable threshold or defined metric for evaluation.

questions.question_text: The term 'easy' in 'easy to upgrade' is subjective and unmeasurable. What specific measurable criteria, time limits, or step limits (e.g., maximum allowable downtime, execution time, or automated procedure requirements) should be specified for upgrading the system?

answers.answer_text: No document-defined threshold exists, but the document already establishes the delivery mechanism: hardware fixes/patches are applied via internet connection (PURE-GAMMA-J-0049) and the system is USB-portable (0043/0044). Proposing: an upgrade is applied via the existing internet-connection patch mechanism, completes in under 15 minutes, and requires no manual steps beyond confirming the install.

test_strategy.rationale: The requirement specifies a timing constraint ('completing each upgrade in under 15 minutes'), which directly indicates performance testing. The 15-minute execution limit represents a numeric threshold suitable for boundary value analysis (e.g., testing duration boundaries around 15 minutes). Additionally, the requirement describes an end-to-end workflow involving user interaction (confirming the install) followed by automated patching, making use case testing applicable for validating the complete multi-step scenario.

test_cases.title: Verify end-to-end upgrade workflow with single user confirmation
test_cases.preconditions: The system is powered on, connected to the internet, and a new patch upgrade is available.
steps: When the install confirmation dialog appears, select 'Confirm'.
Observe the upgrade process without providing any further manual inputs or interactions.
test_cases.expected_result: The system applies the upgrade via the internet-connection patch mechanism and returns to an operational state with zero additional manual steps required.

test_cases.title: Verify upgrade execution duration under standard network conditions
test_cases.preconditions: System is connected to standard broadband internet (>10 Mbps bandwidth).
steps: Confirm the installation and start a high-precision timer immediately upon confirmation.
Monitor the upgrade until final completion confirmation is displayed.
Stop the timer and record total elapsed time.
test_cases.expected_result: The total upgrade completion time is strictly less than 15 minutes (900 seconds).

test_cases.title: Boundary analysis of upgrade completion duration threshold (14m 59s vs 15m 00s)
test_cases.preconditions: Network bandwidth is artificially throttled to simulate realistic worst-case network latency within allowable bounds.
steps: Stage a maximum-sized allowable patch package.
Confirm the install prompt and begin timing.
Verify system status as duration approaches the 15-minute boundary (e.g., at 14 minutes 59 seconds).
test_cases.expected_result: The patch upgrade completes successfully before the 15-minute threshold (<= 14 minutes 59 seconds). If execution reaches 15 minutes without finishing, the system handles the timeout per boundary specifications.
